## PR Description

Fixes #1467

## Root cause

All six red runs fail **byte-identically** at step (3): `contains 'above fold'` sampled the screen **once**, 1500 ms after the End keypress. Three captured logs pulled via the jobs API (38002573433, 38015188200, 38047875908 + family) show the same 21-row glass: held rule gone, newest rows at the live edge, board + busy intact — only the live-fold hint missing at sample time.

The re-engage frame rides the 10 Hz spinner repaints while the sleep-8 tool holds the run open, so a blind sleep + a single sample races the cell-diff paint path — the exact family the same file already documents and settles around for its **absence** assertions (`#550/#557`, gh-1049 capture-don't-re-read). Product-side, the follow painter provably renders the hint in every reachable live state (model-level `fa_tui_follow_mode_test` + `fa_tui_viewport_fold_test` stay green; model+frame timeline sim over the real `view()` pipeline reproduces the healthy frame), so the durable fix is the harness's own anchored-wait discipline — the issue's explicit second lane ("fix the product code **or test determinism** per the issue's intent").

## Delivered

- [x] End re-engage **anchored on the hint itself**: `waitForScreen(\d+ lines? above fold)` — a fold that never re-engages still fails LOUDLY (TimeoutException carries the screen + raw tail), so the regression stays guarded while the single-sample race dies
- [x] End keypress retried **once** on wait timeout (a lost PTY navigation keystroke is transport, not product); the final assertion still demands the hint on glass
- [x] Absence set (`● N new` / `NN% · `) + `Background jobs` assert on a screen settled after the anchored capture — same discipline as step (2)
- [x] Workspace tempdir via `Directory.systemTemp` (host-portable; identical to /tmp on CI linux)
- [x] `dart analyze` clean on the changed file; `pty_screen_wait_reg_test` (the gh-1049 grep guard) + `fa_tui_follow_mode_test` (23 tests) + `fa_tui_viewport_fold_test` (32 tests) green locally

## PR Description

Fixes #1467

## Root cause

All six red runs fail **byte-identically** at step (3): `contains 'above fold'` sampled the screen **once**, 1500 ms after the End keypress. Three captured logs pulled via the jobs API (38002573433, 38015188200, 38047875908 + family) show the same 21-row glass: held rule gone, newest rows at the live edge, board + busy intact — only the live-fold hint missing at sample time.

The re-engage frame rides the 10 Hz spinner repaints while the sleep-8 tool holds the run open, so a blind sleep + a single sample races the cell-diff paint path — the exact family the same file already documents and settles around for its **absence** assertions (`#550/#557`, gh-1049 capture-don't-re-read). Product-side, the follow painter provably renders the hint in every reachable live state (model-level `fa_tui_follow_mode_test` + `fa_tui_viewport_fold_test` stay green; model+frame timeline sim over the real `view()` pipeline reproduces the healthy frame), so the durable fix is the harness's own anchored-wait discipline — the issue's explicit second lane ("fix the product code **or test determinism** per the issue's intent").

## Delivered

- [x] End re-engage **anchored on the hint itself**: `waitForScreen(\d+ lines? above fold)` — a fold that never re-engages still fails LOUDLY (TimeoutException carries the screen + raw tail), so the regression stays guarded while the single-sample race dies
- [x] End keypress retried **once** on wait timeout (a lost PTY navigation keystroke is transport, not product); the final assertion still demands the hint on glass
- [x] Absence set (`● N new` / `NN% · `) + `Background jobs` assert on a screen settled after the anchored capture — same discipline as step (2)
- [x] Workspace tempdir via `Directory.systemTemp` (host-portable; identical to /tmp on CI linux)
- [x] `dart analyze` clean on the changed file; `pty_screen_wait_reg_test` (the gh-1049 grep guard) + `fa_tui_follow_mode_test` (23 tests) + `fa_tui_viewport_fold_test` (32 tests) green locally

## Not touched / remaining

- [ ] **Quarantine list untouched**: PR #1468 (bot) owns the `fa_tui_follow_pty_test.dart` entry. Un-quarantine this file after the fix lands, per gh-1199 AC4: nightly repeat-run proof (this branch keeps the test's full assertions, so the nightly evidence carries over unchanged).
- [ ] Sibling lane #1488 reshapes the shared `pty_harness.dart` — this branch does not touch the harness (test-only diff vs `origin/main` 2864fc9444), so no rebase needed; if #1488 lands first, this merges clean on top.

## Root cause

All six red runs fail **byte-identically** at step (3): `contains 'above fold'` sampled the screen **once**, 1500 ms after the End keypress. Three captured logs pulled via the jobs API (38002573433, 38015188200, 38047875908 + family) show the same 21-row glass: held rule gone, newest rows at the live edge, board + busy intact — only the live-fold hint missing at sample time.

## Delivered

- [x] End re-engage **anchored on the hint itself**: `waitForScreen(\d+ lines? above fold)` — a fold that never re-engages still fails LOUDLY (TimeoutException carries the screen + raw tail), so the regression stays guarded while the single-sample race dies
- [x] End keypress retried **once** on wait timeout (a lost PTY navigation keystroke is transport, not product); the final assertion still demands the hint on glass
- [x] Absence set (`● N new` / `NN% · `) + `Background jobs` assert on a screen settled after the anchored capture — same discipline as step (2)
- [x] Workspace tempdir via `Directory.systemTemp` (host-portable; identical to /tmp on CI linux)

## PR Description

Fixes #1467

## Root cause

All six red runs fail **byte-identically** at step (3): `contains 'above fold'` sampled the screen **once**, 1500 ms after the End keypress. Three captured logs pulled via the jobs API (38002573433, 38015188200, 38047875908 + family) show the same 21-row glass: held rule gone, newest rows at the live edge, board + busy intact — only the live-fold hint missing at sample time.

The re-engage frame rides the 10 Hz spinner repaints while the sleep-8 tool holds the run open, so a blind sleep + a single sample races the cell-diff paint path — the exact family the same file already documents and settles around for its **absence** assertions (`#550/#557`, gh-1049 capture-don't-re-read). Product-side, the follow painter provably renders the hint in every reachable live state (model-level `fa_tui_follow_mode_test` + `fa_tui_viewport_fold_test` stay green; model+frame timeline sim over the real `view()` pipeline reproduces the healthy frame), so the durable fix is the harness's own anchored-wait discipline — the issue's explicit second lane ("fix the product code **or test determinism** per the issue's intent").

## Delivered

- [x] End re-engage **anchored on the hint itself**: `waitForScreen(\d+ lines? above fold)` — a fold that never re-engages still fails LOUDLY (TimeoutException carries the screen + raw tail), so the regression stays guarded while the single-sample race dies
- [x] End keypress retried **once** on wait timeout (a lost PTY navigation keystroke is transport, not product); the final assertion still demands the hint on glass
- [x] Absence set (`● N new` / `NN% · `) + `Background jobs` assert on a screen settled after the anchored capture — same discipline as step (2)
- [x] Workspace tempdir via `Directory.systemTemp` (host-portable; identical to /tmp on CI linux)
- [x] `dart analyze` clean on the changed file; `pty_screen_wait_reg_test` (the gh-1049 grep guard) + `fa_tui_follow_mode_test` (23 tests) + `fa_tui_viewport_fold_test` (32 tests) green locally

## Not touched / remaining

- [ ] **Quarantine list untouched**: PR #1468 (bot) owns the `fa_tui_follow_pty_test.dart` entry. Un-quarantine this file after the fix lands, per gh-1199 AC4: nightly repeat-run proof (this branch keeps the test's full assertions, so the nightly evidence carries over unchanged).
- [ ] Sibling lane #1488 reshapes the shared `pty_harness.dart` — this branch does not touch the harness (test-only diff vs `origin/main` 2864fc9444), so no rebase needed; if #1488 lands first, this merges clean on top.
- No product-code change in this PR; if a future nightly red lands WITH the anchored wait in place, the TimeoutException diagnostics (screen + raw tail) give the exact glass state for a product-level follow-up.

## PR Description

Fixes #1467

## Root cause

All six red runs fail **byte-identically** at step (3): `contains 'above fold'` sampled the screen **once**, 1500 ms after the End keypress. Three captured logs pulled via the jobs API (38002573433, 38015188200, 38047875908 + family) show the same 21-row glass: held rule gone, newest rows at the live edge, board + busy intact — only the live-fold hint missing at sample time.

The re-engage frame rides the 10 Hz spinner repaints while the sleep-8 tool holds the run open, so a blind sleep + a single sample races the cell-diff paint path — the exact family the same file already documents and settles around for its **absence** assertions (`#550/#557`, gh-1049 capture-don't-re-read). Product-side, the follow painter provably renders the hint in every reachable live state (model-level `fa_tui_follow_mode_test` + `fa_tui_viewport_fold_test` stay green; model+frame timeline sim over the real `view()` pipeline reproduces the healthy frame), so the durable fix is the harness's own anchored-wait discipline — the issue's explicit second lane ("fix the product code **or test determinism** per the issue's intent").

## Delivered

- [x] End re-engage **anchored on the hint itself**: `waitForScreen(\d+ lines? above fold)` — a fold that never re-engages still fails LOUDLY (TimeoutException carries the screen + raw tail), so the regression stays guarded while the single-sample race dies
- [x] End keypress retried **once** on wait timeout (a lost PTY navigation keystroke is transport, not product); the final assertion still demands the hint on glass
- [x] Absence set (`● N new` / `NN% · `) + `Background jobs` assert on a screen settled after the anchored capture — same discipline as step (2)
- [x] Workspace tempdir via `Directory.systemTemp` (host-portable; identical to /tmp on CI linux)
- [x] `dart analyze` clean on the changed file; `pty_screen_wait_reg_test` (the gh-1049 grep guard) + `fa_tui_follow_mode_test` (23 tests) + `fa_tui_viewport_fold_test` (32 tests) green locally

## Not touched / remaining

- [ ] **Quarantine list untouched**: PR #1468 (bot) owns the `fa_tui_follow_pty_test.dart` entry. Un-quarantine this file after the fix lands, per gh-1199 AC4: nightly repeat-run proof (this branch keeps the test's full assertions, so the nightly evidence carries over unchanged).
- [ ] Sibling lane #1488 reshapes the shared `pty_harness.dart` — this branch does not touch the harness (test-only diff vs `origin/main` 2864fc9444), so no rebase needed; if #1488 lands first, this merges clean on top.

🚨 **BLOCKING: the anchored wait targets text gh-1446 retracted — the test now fails deterministically**

The new anchor `RegExp(r'\d+ lines? above fold')` can never match the current product. gh-1446 (merged in e2462c10c, present on this branch) made the streaming fold row **textless** — `lib/src/cli/fa_tui_rows.dart` `_writeScrollIndicator` renders a plain dim `─` rule while `followTail && above > 0`, and the only surviving occurrence of the words "above fold" in product code is a doc comment. The file's own header (line 10-11) and step-(2) assertions still document this: "gh-1446 retracted the #827 hint words, so no fold text ever returns".

I ran the changed test locally on this branch:

```bash
dart test test/integration/fa_tui_follow_pty_test.dart
```

→ **fails deterministically**: first wait (10 s) times out, the End retry fires, second wait (30 s) times out at `fa_tui_follow_pty_test.dart:152`, test fails after ~40 s. The TimeoutException's own screen dump shows a *healthy* re-engaged frame — newest rows at the live edge, textless fold rules on glass, `Background jobs` present — the product is fine; the anchor is wrong. (This also explains why the PR description's "green locally" list only names the model-level suites `fa_tui_follow_mode_test` / `fa_tui_viewport_fold_test` — the changed PTY test itself, quarantined and nightly-only, was never run.)

Note the wait is also self-contradictory: `waitForScreen` returns the exact snapshot that *matched* the pattern (gh-1049 capture semantics), so if it ever succeeded, the very next assertion `expect(live, isNot(contains('above fold')))` (line 161) would fail on that same string.

**Fix**: anchor on what the gh-1446 contract actually paints at re-engage — the textless fold rule this test already asserts two lines below:

```dart
live = await harness.waitForScreen(
  RegExp(r'^─{30,}\s*$', multiLine: true),
  timeout: const Duration(seconds: 10),
);
```

(or anchor on `Background jobs`). That marker is sustained at the live edge, so the anchored capture remains a true re-engage proof, the single-sample race still dies, and a fold that never re-engages still fails LOUDLY with the screen attached.

💡 **SUGGESTION: run the changed test itself before merge**

This PR fixes a nightly-only quarantined test, and the description's verification list covers only the model-level suites — not `fa_tui_follow_pty_test.dart`, the one file actually changed (the blocker in the sibling thread is the direct result). Since the nightly shard is the first place this test executes, a wrong anchor ships silently and burns a nightly cycle. Locally the test runs in ~1 min on Linux with `dart test test/integration/fa_tui_follow_pty_test.dart` — worth adding to the PR checklist (and its output to the description) for any future change to this file.

## Root cause

All six red runs fail **byte-identically** at step (3): `contains 'above fold'` sampled the screen **once**, 1500 ms after the End keypress. Three captured logs pulled via the jobs API (38002573433, 38015188200, 38047875908 + family) show the same 21-row glass: held rule gone, newest rows at the live edge, board + busy intact — only the live-fold hint missing at sample time.

## Delivered

- [x] End re-engage **anchored on the hint itself**: `waitForScreen(\d+ lines? above fold)` — a fold that never re-engages still fails LOUDLY (TimeoutException carries the screen + raw tail), so the regression stays guarded while the single-sample race dies
- [x] End keypress retried **once** on wait timeout (a lost PTY navigation keystroke is transport, not product); the final assertion still demands the hint on glass
- [x] Absence set (`● N new` / `NN% · `) + `Background jobs` assert on a screen settled after the anchored capture — same discipline as step (2)
- [x] Workspace tempdir via `Directory.systemTemp` (host-portable; identical to /tmp on CI linux)
